ORBITAL NOTES (our SaaS) — VULNERABILITY TRIAGE LADDER, security@ runbook §3

Assign the first matching priority, checking from the top:
  P0 (fix or mitigate within 24 h): evidence of active exploitation in production, OR CVSS ≥ 9.0 and the vulnerable code path is reachable in production by unauthenticated users.
  P1 (fix within 7 days): CVSS ≥ 7.0 and reachable in production by any user (authenticated or not).
  P2 (fix within 30 days): the vulnerable code path is not reachable in production at present (e.g. feature flag off for every production tenant, dead code), whatever its score.
  P3 (backlog): informational / hardening only.
  Out of scope: the affected asset is operated by a third party, not by us.
"Production" means every tenant on the prod cluster, including internal, demo and sandbox tenants hosted there. The staging cluster is not production.

BUG BOUNTY REPORT BB-2026-0412 (received 2026-09-19 07:55 UTC)
Title: Unauthenticated RCE via crafted SVG in image resizer v2
Component: media-svc, endpoint GET /v2/resize?src=...
Researcher CVSS 3.1: 9.8 — our re-score: 9.1 (Critical)
Auth: none required; /v2/resize serves public embedded images.
Researcher's PoC run against: staging.orbitalnotes.dev

Internal checks
- Feature flag img_resize_v2 (prod cluster config, fetched 08:30 UTC):
    default: OFF
    overrides: [ {tenant: "acme-demo-internal", value: ON, set_by: "sales-eng", set_at: "2026-09-04"} ]
- Flag changelog comment 2026-08-02: "img_resize_v2 disabled everywhere after perf regression."
- WAF/access logs, prod, last 30 days: 1,904 requests to /v2/resize, all from tenant acme-demo-internal embeds; no payloads matching the PoC signature.
- Tenant registry: acme-demo-internal — cluster: prod-eu-1; type: internal demo tenant (publicly reachable demo pages).
Engineer on triage: "Flag has been off since August, so this is a P2."

decision.instructions: Apply the triage ladder to BB-2026-0412. Which priority must be assigned?

criteria.out_of_scope: The affected asset is operated by a third party.
criteria.p0_fix_24h: Active exploitation in production, or CVSS ≥ 9.0 and reachable in production without authentication.
criteria.p1_fix_7d: CVSS ≥ 7.0, reachable in production, but P0 conditions not met.
criteria.p2_fix_30d: The vulnerable path is not reachable in production right now.
